author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, soft and loud, word rhythm and calm playing together, with a gentle old lullaby.

classes.title: Rock teddy to sleep
classes.goal: Feel the slow, steady beat of the lullaby with the whole body.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling something that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child on your lap and rock slowly side to side on every beat.
classes.childAction: Hug teddy and rock with the song.
classes.bridge: The beat is a rocking cradle: side, side, slow and soft.

intro.caption: Let's rock teddy to sleep
intro.parentCue: hold your child and rock slowly with them

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling a slow steady beat, together.

classes.title: Pat-pat, sleepy beat
classes.goal: Tap one gentle tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat, like patting a baby.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one soft pat on a sleepy baby's back.

intro.caption: Pat, pat, one beat, one tap
intro.parentCue: pat your child's back softly on each beat

games.caption: Pat the mockingbird beat
games.parentCue: Pat softly, never in a hurry

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one gentle tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl softly for the bear; flap your arms and chirp for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a sleepy bear on the left; high notes are the mockingbird.

intro.caption: Bear lives low, bird lives high
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, right for the bird

games.caption: Bird! The mockingbird sings
games.parentCue: Chirp together, then tap the right side

games.caption: Bear! Big sleepy bear
games.parentCue: Growl softly, then tap the left side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big taps, hush taps
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny hush taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make strong arms for loud taps; whisper 'shh' and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big strong taps. Soft: tiny hush taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a big drum; soft taps are a whisper to the baby.

intro.caption: Big taps, then hush taps
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Sleepy slow, awake fast
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Walk your fingers up your child's arm, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are a sleepy turtle; fast taps are a wide-awake bunny.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny time, awake song!
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Hush! Freeze, baby
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze with a quiet 'shh' when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: When the music stops, put a finger to your lips and freeze; cheer when it restarts.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze and say 'shh' when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, we tap; music off, the baby sleeps, so we freeze.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... hush and freeze!
intro.parentCue: finger to your lips when the music stops

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Ma-ma: two taps
classes.goal: Tap once for each piece of a word, like Ma-ma, two taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each piece of a word you sing

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly and tap your child's hand once for each word piece.
classes.childAction: Ma-ma: two taps, one for each piece.
classes.bridge: Each word piece is one soft footstep on the keys: Ma, ma.

intro.caption: Ma-ma: one, two taps
intro.parentCue: say Ma-ma slowly and tap twice

games.caption: Mama's gonna buy you
games.parentCue: Say each word piece with each light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word piece.

classes.title: Guess the lullaby game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, drum, whisper, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: What game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; any guess is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: Lullaby duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune softly and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune is the lullaby; your beat is the cradle rocking under it.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Goodnight concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole lullaby from start to end, then tuck teddy in together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap softly and tuck teddy in.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then whisper goodnight to teddy.
classes.bridge: The song is a bedtime walk: start awake, end with a goodnight.

intro.caption: A song for teddy
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
